title: Scripture and Teaching
definition: Scripture and Teaching means God’s Word must shape what is taught, how it is taught, and why it is taught among God’s people.
summary: Scripture and Teaching means God’s Word must shape what is taught, how it is taught, and why it is taught among God’s people.
christFocus: Jesus taught with authority and trained His followers to teach others to obey all that He commanded.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical teaching is not merely sharing opinions, stories, or inspiration. It is helping people understand God’s Word so they can know Christ and follow Him faithfully.

Teachers must handle Scripture carefully because teaching shapes souls. The goal is not to display knowledge but to serve people with truth. Teaching should be clear, humble, accurate, and aimed at discipleship.

Christ is the center of faithful teaching. The teacher does not replace Christ, compete with Christ, or draw disciples after themselves. They point hearers to the Lord who speaks through His Word.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people have been confused or hurt by teaching that was careless, controlling, or personality-centered. Scripture and teaching calls teachers back to humble service under God’s Word.

This doctrine also encourages ordinary believers who teach children, recovery groups, Bible studies, or small gatherings. Faithful teaching does not require fame; it requires Scripture, love, and dependence on the Spirit.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: If you teach, prepare with prayer and humility. Explain the Word clearly, point to Christ, avoid speculation, and aim for obedience. If you are learning, receive faithful teaching eagerly but test it by Scripture.
